claim_boundary: This is local CIP-label validation, not whole-molecule chirality accuracy. Non-exact records remain typed limitations.

stereomolgraph.reason: No local CIP-label assignment API is exposed.

method: RDKit supplies parsed relative stereo descriptors. For declared AT, HE, CT4, CT, and fully witnessed cumulene carriers, the optional pinned 3D file supplies orientation only when constitutional transport is unambiguous; AT additionally requires one confirmed carrier. SynKit independently ranks ligands with exact nuclide masses and projects local label sets
